author: Nerdstalgic
description:
When The Mandalorian first arrived on Disney+, it felt like something Star Wars had been missing for years. 

Instead of another story about the fate of the galaxy or the Skywalker lineage, we got a lone bounty hunter, a strange baby version of Yoda, and a surprisingly personal adventure in a galaxy far, far away.

But somewhere along the way that simplicity disappeared.  Suddenly, keeping up with Mando and Grogu meant keeping up with other shows, familiar characters, and an increasingly complicated web of Star Wars lore. What once felt like its own little corner of the galaxy started to feel like another assignment in a franchise that never seems to know when to stop expanding.

And now, even the move to the big screen raises the same question: what happened to the show we fell in love with?

title: How Disney Broke The Mandalorian
